meta.title: Sisir: post-quantum Solidity lint for QoreChain
meta.description: Paste a Solidity contract and see QoreChain post-quantum mistakes in your browser. Eight rules, each with the official docs.

header.tagline: I check Solidity for QoreChain post-quantum mistakes. Everything runs in this browser.

footer.complement: Sisir is a complement to the official auditor, not a replacement. The rules are syntax checks and miss things.
footer.rules: What each rule catches and misses
footer.credit: The examples are the workshop 2 audit vault from qorechain/build-before-qday (Apache-2.0).

anchor.title: Ledger
anchor.heading: Anchor this report
anchor.intro: I can record this inspection on the QoreChain testnet. The chain keeps two hashes and the findings count, never your code.
anchor.empty: Pick or paste a contract to get a report to anchor.
anchor.parse: This source does not parse, so there is no report to anchor.
anchor.noLedger: The ledger is not deployed yet, so anchoring is off for now. The hashes above are what it will store.
anchor.copyBlockedHint: Your browser blocked the clipboard. Select the full hash below.
anchor.step1Hint: Testnet only. The wallet asks before anything is signed.
anchor.step2Hint: QoreX signs this with your secp256k1 and ML-DSA-87 keys together. The window allows {txs} call to the ledger for {blocks} blocks.
anchor.windowOther: QoreX connected the EVM address {evm}. It has a different key from the native account, so this window does not cover it.
anchor.step3Hint: This calls SisirLedger.anchor with the two hashes and the findings count.

error.exhausted: The window is used up. Open a new one in step 2.
error.notReady: The ledger refused: this account's post-quantum key is not registered with proof of possession.
